metric_definitions_units.stable_horizon_risk: Source evidence horizon_risks[5 or 8].value: original ceil-top10 risk over stable, available complete-horizon objective_point_error.mean_point_error; eligible and unresolved IDs retained. Risk is not RMSE.
metric_definitions_units.score_perturbation: Source numerical_score_perturbation = absolute difference between fine and coarse ceil-top10 score; source evidence units/scale retained.
metric_definitions_units.common_frequency: Mass-weighted common-frequency error RMSE summary across events; underlying scalar is angular frequency, rad/s. official mean/pooled/cvar10/worst retained.
metric_definitions_units.normalized_p: Checkpoint p_scale-normalized error RMSE summary; dimensionless. official mean/pooled/cvar10/worst retained.
metric_definitions_units.unstable_physical_components: Source records.unstable_prefix.official delta_rmse_rad in rad and omega_rmse_rad_s in rad/s; accompanying aggregate fields retained as defined in source.
metric_definitions_units.classification_denominators: Miss denominator is eligible unstable count (unstable_count minus unresolved unstable samples); false-positive denominator is eligible stable count (event_count minus unstable_count minus unresolved stable samples). Unresolved samples are subtracted only from their corresponding truth-class denominator.
